q: Whose X-ray diffraction work produced 'Photo 51', the image that revealed DNA's helical shape?
explain: Rosalind Franklin used X-ray diffraction to study DNA, and her famous Photo 51 revealed its helical shape, helping to elucidate the double helix structure.

sources.title: DNA | Britannica
sources.quote: In 1952, scientist Rosalind Franklin, using X-ray diffraction, captured her famous “Photo 51,” which revealed the helical shape of DNA.

sources.title: 9.1 The Structure of DNA - Concepts of Biology | OpenStax
sources.quote: Scientist Rosalind Franklin discovered the X-ray diffraction pattern of DNA, which helped to elucidate its double helix structure.
